Forecast Discussion

Warm high pressure controls our weather through Friday morning. We are at or above record highs for this date this afternoon. A rogue light shower is possible in the NC counties bordering Virginia this afternoon.

A game-changing cold front blows through Friday afternoon. It brings the coldest air of the season thus far on gusty NW winds. Saturday is impressively chilly -- 30 degrees cooler than today! Expect frost both Sunday and Monday mornings.

There is a little rain associated with the front and the NW flow behind it. A stray shower is possible Friday afternoon. Then a few more light showers develop Friday night into Saturday morning. Buckle up for gusty winds late Friday into Saturday.

High pressure moves into Virginia Sunday. It remains to our north Monday and Tuesday. We have to watch for a weak low developing off the SC coast Monday, but it appears too far east to bring showers or even clouds. It does keep a cool easterly breeze going.

The pattern relaxes, and milder air returns Tuesday and Wednesday. It’s beautiful fall weather next week after the weekend chill.
